definitions.explanation: The five faculties of sight, hearing, smell, taste, and touch.

examples.japanese: {五感|ごかん}を{使|つか}って{料理|りょうり}を{味|あじ}わう。
examples.english: I enjoy food using all five senses.

examples.japanese: {五感|ごかん}を{研|と}ぎ{澄|す}ます。
{五感|ごかん}で{自然|しぜん}を{感|かん}じる。
examples.english: To experience nature with all five senses.

notes:
THE FIVE SENSES:
- {視覚|しかく}: sight
- {聴覚|ちょうかく}: hearing
- {嗅覚|きゅうかく}: smell
- {味覚|みかく}: taste
- {触覚|しょっかく}: touch

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {五感|ごかん}を{使|つか}う: to use all five senses
- {五感|ごかん}を{刺激|しげき}する: to stimulate the senses
- {五感|ごかん}を{研|と}ぎ{澄|す}ます: to sharpen one's senses
- {五感|ごかん}で{感|かん}じる: to feel with all senses

RELATED EXPRESSION:
- {第六感|だいろっかん}: sixth sense, intuition
